set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-research.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: AC1-2 are completed elsewhere: ADR b9b23952 precedes compiler fix 10290a12 and witness 7469d3d7, all on main; evidence/p1-integration-20260923. The child closed by provider-contract supersession does not establish this pilot.

Remaining / next action: Resume only the proposition/spine versus best retrieval Sherlock development pilot (AC3-7), with preregistered participant-average estimand and advisory adopt/reject/unavailable readout.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: research. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Research comparison retained; frozen exposure/eligibility rules apply. Not an engineering prerequisite or proof of behavioral recovery.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 3 H5.

The typed story compiler has never validated a real text: all three blocking errors on the War of the Ghosts compile sit at s43, where the provider abstained. Related: bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG (a real proposition provider, 50 of 50 sentences). Under ruling A the pilot informs mapper design; it does not gate D1A-film.

Scope:
ADR amendment first, then the fix, then the pilot.

Acceptance criteria:
1. An ADR 0005 amendment for a typed absence on an abstained derivation is committed before code.
2. The War of the Ghosts compile validates, or a court names exactly why it does not.
3. The pilot compares a proposition-level channel (d_chart, or atomic claims plus NLI) with the best retrieval channel on Sherlock development data.
4. The result is recorded as advisory to mapper design.
5. Each sub-arm has a ledger entry before its first gold read and runs through recall-map on development data only.
6. Each sub-arm is compared with the current best development configuration on the pre-declared participant-average estimand.
7. The outcome of each sub-arm is recorded as adopt, reject or unavailable, with the evidence; adoption changes the shipping candidate only through a committed config change.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: M.
